segments.text: At {{candidates.json#candidates[id=c14_7_21].pressure_psi}} ({{candidates.json#candidates[id=c14_7_21].pressure_kpa}}) and {{candidates.json#candidates[id=c14_7_21].o2_pct}} oxygen, the PSI experiment tables hold {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].near_total}} tests within the nearness region: {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].near.gas.psi_table}} gas flames, {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].near.droplet.psi_table}} droplet tests, {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].near.solid.psi_table}} solid-material tests and {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].near.emulator.psi_table}} BRE emulator tests. This is the atmosphere of the ISS and of Earth at sea level.

A further {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].o2_match_pressure_unknown.solid}} solid-material tests and {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].o2_match_pressure_unknown.emulator}} BRE sessions record a matching oxygen level but no pressure, so they cannot be placed on the plane.

The adiabatic flame temperature of stoichiometric methane here is {{candidate_evidence.json#evidence[candidate_id=c14_7_21].flame_temperature}}. It explains how hot a flame can get; it does not predict whether a material ignites or how fast a flame spreads.

items.not_covered: Not covered here: partial gravity (PSI holds no partial-gravity combustion data), flame spread rates as downloadable rows, and any test at this exact pressure for fabrics or plastics in the PSI tables.

The ACME BRE flight objectives name it as a NASA-considered atmosphere.

NASA has burned fabric and plastic close to this atmosphere: Saffire VI burned SIBAL cloth and PMMA inside a Cygnus vehicle at {{key_findings.json#findings[id=FND-S6-COND-P-O2].values[name=VI-2 ambient pressure]}} to {{key_findings.json#findings[id=FND-S6-COND-P-O2].values[name=VI-4 ambient pressure]}}, with oxygen between {{key_findings.json#findings[id=FND-S6-COND-P-O2].values[name=VI-4 oxygen concentration]}} and {{key_findings.json#findings[id=FND-S6-COND-P-O2].values[name=VI-2 oxygen concentration]}}. Those results are published in a paper, not as rows in the PSI tables.
